Nov 23, 2026 Lionel Messi threw the ball directly into Gonzalo Tapia’s face during Inter Miami’s 3 to 0 MLS playoff defeat to Columbus Crew. The referee showed a yellow card, but should Messi have been sent off? The incident happened November 21, 2026, at Nu Stadium in Miami. With Inter Miami trailing 1 to 0 and playing with 10 men after Gonzalo Luján’s red card, Messi tried to restart play with a throw in. Tapia stood close to the touchline, obstructing the restart, before Messi threw the ball into his face. Referee Allen Chapman cautioned both players and later said the force did not meet the threshold for violent conduct. Columbus coach Laurent Courtois disagreed, arguing that Messi deserved a red card. Under football's rules, a reckless throw may warrant a yellow card, while excessive force requires a red. MLS can also review certain incidents after matches, although no additional punishment has been confirmed. Columbus won 3 to 0, with Tapia scoring twice. Miami now faces elimination in the November 27 return match. #news #viral #CaughtOnCamera #fyp #ViralVideo
